interpretation: Neither scaffold requires a role-by-scenario cross product. The 20 governed-task Maude scenarios are one run each and their ten roles are coverage constraints. The 10 installation and first-run specimens separately cover five installation backgrounds as coverage constraints, with each background represented twice rather than crossed with every condition. Five direct-runtime runs are additional controls for the governed-task track, not substitutes; the Maude-only installation track has no task-equivalent direct-runtime comparator.

model_family_policy.limitation: Claude is unavailable for this campaign. Every operator and grader uses gpt-5.6-sol through openai-sol in a separate genuinely fresh Codex session; no opposite-family grade or cross-family model comparison is supported.

all_runs.purpose: reveal the fixed questionnaire only after a nonempty initial disposition

installation_runs.purpose: provide neutral persistent PTY transport for an arbitrary operator-selected command across start/read/send/status/stop calls while preserving exact PTY bytes

product_command_count_exclusions: do not double-count a PTY start and its wrapped product executable; every adapter provider action remains an interaction step

installation_track.direct_runtime_comparator: not task-equivalent; this track is explicitly Maude-only
installation_track.interpretation: The five installation backgrounds are coverage constraints, not a background-by-condition cross product. Ten fresh runs isolate discovery and documented install, configuration and first use, seven common conditions, upgrade, and removal. Each background appears twice.
installation_track.source_visibility: Docs-only by default. install-i03 receives a frozen baseline release-source archive. Preinstalled runs expose only mechanically real installed distribution bytes. Every exception is explicit; no git metadata, tests, architecture notes, sibling checkout, or evaluator expectations are exposed.

round: Round A baseline, including adversarial and fatigue specimens; no repair round is authorized

openai-sol.tool_boundary: Strict per-session direct stdio MCP. The operator receives only mcp__operator__terminal (enabled as terminal); the grader receives only mcp__grader__evidence (enabled as evidence). Codex built-in and intrinsic action features are disabled.
openai-sol.transport_boundary: Codex runs in a task-blind retained-auth transport namespace with no task paths or task sockets. A trusted direct stdio MCP shim shares that namespace and can read retained provider authentication until transport exit.
openai-sol.broker_boundary: The operator command broker receives neither provider credentials nor semantic prompts; each command executes in a fresh per-command no-network mount/PID namespace. The grader evidence tool is read-only.
openai-sol.boundary_limitation: The trusted direct stdio shim is part of the retained-auth transport boundary and can read provider authentication by construction; the campaign proves task paths and task sockets are absent, not provider-internal noninspection. Claude is unavailable, so cross-family isolation comparison is unsupported.
